## 2024-05-24 - React state with large base64 payload payloads
**Learning:** Large base64 data URI payloads (like those generated by the Gemini API here) stored in React state can cause significantly expensive UI diffing and re-rendering when parent components update.
**Action:** Always proactively memoize child components (`React.memo`) that consume these payloads and ensure all their callback props are strictly memoized (`useCallback`) to prevent severe UI freezes.
